scope: Native Photos picker UI regression, owned anonymous Simulator fixtures only; no live account or sends.
cause: iOS26 Photos exposes asset tiles as Image accessibility elements under ScrollView/Other containers, not CollectionView cells. Their visible frames exist, but XCTest reports no activation hit point for Image.tap().
fix: Test-only: match Foto,/Photo, or Video, image labels within native.gallery.picker, then tap the observed asset frame center. Use the navigation action identifier Cancel to avoid the onboarding card Close action. App/importer code unchanged.
assertions: System picker opens and cancels without adding an attachment or changing the draft.
Real photo selection appears as an attachment; cancelling a reopened picker preserves that existing attachment and draft.
Real MP4 selection appears as an attachment with supported video suffix and unchanged draft.
Photo/video attachments can be removed without sending or changing the draft.
